stem: What did the federal government do to address the social injustice shown in this photograph?
instruction: Study the photograph and answer the question that follows.

options.label: A
options.text: Enforced the Wisconsin v. Yoder decision protecting First Amendment rights

options.label: B
options.text: Established the Congress of Racial Equality (CORE) to promote voting rights

options.label: C
options.text: Passed civil rights legislation banning segregation in public places

options.label: D
options.text: Issued an executive order prohibiting limits on interstate migration

visual_elements: Photograph of a bus station in Durham, North Carolina, 1940 showing a sign 'COLORED WAITING ROOM' above a man standing near a bus labeled '45' with several passengers visible inside.
